desc:
🥚🔫 SHOOT EGGS, HATCH PETS! 🔫🥚

Blast giant eggs with crazy guns, crack them open and collect awesome pets! Put your pets in your pen to earn cash, unlock stronger guns and push into new zones with bigger eggs and rarer pets!

⭐ FEATURES ⭐
🔫 54 guns, from snowball guns to tesla cannons
🐾 130+ pets, from Common all the way to Ancient
✨ Golden, Diamond, Rainbow, Galaxy, Lava, Lightning & Toxic mutations
🍀 Lucky hatches: the more luck, the rarer the pet
🏃 Train on treadmills to hit harder
🌍 4 zones with tougher eggs
🔁 Rebirth to power up
🧪 Fuse Machine for your pets
🏆 Leaderboards & limited pets

👥 +10% cash for every friend in your server!
🎁 Join the group for a FREE reward chest!

👍 Like & ⭐ Favorite so you don't miss updates!
